news.title: Amazon is already offering new OpenAI products on AWS
news.description: A day after OpenAI got Microsoft to agree to end exclusive rights, AWS announced a slate of OpenAI model offerings, including a new agent service.

news.title: Amazon launches an AI-powered audio Q&A experience on product pages
news.description: Amazon's new "Join the chat" feature lets you ask questions about products and receive AI-powered audio responses.

news.title: Google expands Pentagon’s access to its AI after Anthropic’s refusal
news.description: After Anthropic refused to allow the DoD to use its AI for domestic mass surveillance and autonomous weapons, Google has signed a new contract with the department.

news.title: YouTube is testing an AI-powered search feature that shows guided answers
news.description: YouTube is rolling out the new AI search feature to Premium subscribers in the U.S. on an opt-in basis.

news.title: Musk says basis of charitable giving at stake in OpenAI lawsuit
news.description: The case over OpenAI's history and public commitments could have major implications for the future of AI.

news.title: Why Spotify has no button to filter out AI music
news.description: Music streamer Deezer allows users to filter out AI music, so why does Spotify not offer the same?

news.title: Elon Musk Testifies That He Started OpenAI to Prevent a ‘Terminator Outcome’
news.description: The judge also warned Musk and Sam Altman to curb their “propensity to use social media to make things worse outside the courtroom” after both sides traded attacks online.

news.title: ‘It’s Undignified’: Hundreds of Workers Training Meta’s AI Could Be Laid Off
news.description: More than 700 people working for a Meta contractor in Ireland are at risk of losing their jobs, documents show.
